items.question: What nine same-form elements are to be employed for accomplishing every desired end?
premises: the goal is all desired ends
items.inference: the verse prescribes nine uniform elements for universal siddhi
uncertainties: the exact referent of the nine elements is not explicit in this verse
items.plain_english: Nine same-form elements are for the accomplishment of all desired ends everywhere.
